**AIRIA — AI Art Collection Vol. 01**

Welcome to AIRIA, an independent digital art project exploring the intersection of human creativity and artificial intelligence.

This collection brings together a selection of AI-assisted illustrations, character studies, and visual experiments created through artistic direction, iteration, and digital tools.

Inspired by Japanese anime aesthetics, AIRIA explores original characters, expressive compositions, and different visual atmospheres.

This is only the beginning of the archive.

**Explore more from AIRIA:**

- Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/cw/airiaart
- Official Gallery: https://airia-archive.nimodeck.workers.dev/

Thank you for visiting and supporting independent digital creativity.

*AIRIA — Where imagination meets artificial intelligence.*
